answer: Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. The island edge is written down both ways, so a closed ring of 47 clones produces a signature the whisper analysis flags immediately. An attacker must therefore build an open graph reaching real agents, thus doing work rather than printing keys, and the marble settlement applies the void retroactively. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
